description: The agent's vocabulary for assessing the architecture of any subgraph — its own cortices, the compiler stack it built, an external subsystem. Architectural qualities are scored 0-10 by graph queries; smells are pattern matches against structural shapes. The result is an Assessment node, graph-resident, queryable, and the input to the code-writing cortex when an architectural improvement is wanted.

qualities.name: separation_of_concerns
qualities.definition: Distinct responsibilities live in distinct nodes; no node is doing two jobs that would change for different reasons.
qualities.measured_by: Variance in the SIZE of each reflex's `concerns` list (the state keys it reads/writes). Tightly-scoped responsibilities → uniformly small concerns lists → low variance → high score. Falls back to priority-variance if no reflex annotates its concerns yet (legacy proxy; priorities are intrinsically spread for the scheduler so this metric over-penalises healthy cortices — `concerns` is the real signal).
qualities.rationale: Why it matters — coupled responsibilities means a change in one requires a change in the other; this is what makes evolution expensive.

qualities.name: abstraction_layering
qualities.definition: Higher-level Microtheories inherit from lower-level ones via genlMt; there is a clear vertical structure rather than a flat soup.
qualities.measured_by: Depth of the longest genlMt chain reachable from any Mt owned by the subject. Deeper layering → more careful abstraction → higher score.
qualities.rationale: Cyc taught us this: ist-formulae need a Microtheory hierarchy to disambiguate scope. Without layers, every concept must hold globally — that's unsoundness waiting.

qualities.name: introspectability
qualities.definition: The subject's own behaviour can be read from its graph data; no logic is hidden in Python callables that the agent can't query.
qualities.measured_by: Ratio of (Concept + Rule + Microtheory nodes) to (Reflex nodes carrying Python step callables). Higher ratio → more graph-resident reasoning → higher score.
qualities.rationale: If the agent can't read its own decision logic, it can't modify it. Introspectability is the precondition for self-improvement.

qualities.name: data_drivenness
qualities.definition: Behaviour is governed by graph attrs and edges, not by hardcoded constants in Python source.
qualities.measured_by: Count of nodes whose attrs include 'origin' tracing to a seed file (graph-driven) vs ones synthesised at runtime. Higher → more data-driven → higher score.
qualities.rationale: Updating a JSON seed → answer changes. Updating Python source → answer changes only after a deploy. The former is the agent's natural mode.

qualities.name: compositional_reuse
qualities.definition: The subject's components are reused by other subjects (cross-cortex Microtheory sharing, shared Concepts).
qualities.measured_by: Count of in-edges to the subject's Microtheories + Concepts from OTHER subjects' cortices. Higher → more reuse → higher score.
qualities.rationale: A piece of cognitive content that only one cortex uses is suspect — it might be misplaced or duplicating something a more general subject already owns.

smells.name: god_object
smells.definition: A single node whose outgoing edge-type diversity is a positive OUTLIER relative to the rest of the graph — it carries so many more distinct edge types than its peers that no narrative justifies them all together. Not an absolute count (8 edge types is unremarkable in a densely-typed graph and alarming in a sparse one) — a position on the graph's own diversity distribution.
smells.detected_when: a node's outgoing edge-type diversity exceeds mean + outlier_k * std of that diversity across all nodes
smells.remediation: Split the node into focused sub-nodes connected by a structural relation.

smells.name: circular_inheritance
smells.definition: A Microtheory's genlMt chain reaches back to itself.
smells.detected_when: DFS over genlMt edges encounters a previously-seen Mt
smells.remediation: Pick the more specific Mt as primary; recast the other relationship as concept-level.

smells.name: orphaned_concept
smells.definition: A Concept node with no incoming edges from any Microtheory, Rule, or Reflex — the agent installed it but nothing references it.
smells.remediation: Either delete the concept, or wire the Mt that should own it.

smells.name: redundant_data_in_python
smells.definition: A piece of authoring data lives BOTH in graph nodes AND in a Python dict — the source of truth is split.
smells.detected_when: Module-level dict with same keys as a known seed (heuristic only — agent flags as a smell to investigate)
smells.remediation: Move the Python dict to a seed JSON file; let the graph be the single source of truth.

smells.name: missing_assessment_subject
smells.definition: A Cortex with no `assesses` edge to anything — it has structure but no defined target.
smells.detected_when: Cortex with no assessment-shape outgoing edges
smells.remediation: Either give it a subject (something to do) or remove it.

data_drivenness_config.description: Configuration for the data_drivenness scorer — moved from a hardcoded Python tuple to graph data so adding a new seed or cortex-construction family doesn't require a code change.
data_drivenness_config.rationale: Nodes whose origin is a known seed file are graph-data. Nodes whose origin starts with `cortex_constructed` are dynamically minted DesignPatterns — but they are STILL graph data (the cortex writes them to the graph, the graph is the source of truth). Both kinds count as data-driven; only Python-only state would not.
